notes.title: Ver2.4.6
notes.content:
1.Added a new DLC, "Million Dragons".
This DLC includes divine dragons of five mount qualities. Divine dragons possess the most powerful attributes. After breeding, there is a probability of obtaining attributes that exceed those of mutated mounts by 20%.
Added the artifact - Divine Dragon Sword and its corresponding recipe.
When using this weapon, there is a probability of summoning a divine dragon to assist in the attack. It is the only weapon with a special attack skill.
Added two divine dragon bloodlines. These bloodlines have special effects, and when attacking, a dragon soul will possess the character, and this effect can stack multiple times.

2.Optimized the models, textures, and icons of divine dragons.
Re - opened the Creative Workshop and fixed the problem that self - created characters could not be seen.

3.Fixed the problem that some achievements could not be activated correctly. (If there are still 
achievements that cannot be activated correctly in the future, please feedback to us.)

4.Fixed the problem of abnormal movement of horse mounts.


If you have purchased the game before, you can send the purchase voucher to the email xingyiwangluo2025@163.com to receive the activation code of this DLC for free.

notes.title: Ver2.4.5（Beta）
notes.content:
The new version has been updated to Beta. If there are no bugs for two consecutive days, it will be moved to the official version. This will be the process from now on. Those who don't mind can switch to the Beta version to experience the updated content in advance.


We've added a plugin management feature, which can be found at the bottom - right corner of the game's main menu interface. Currently, it only supports these functions. If you have new requirements, please leave a message in the discussion area, and we'll consider adding them accordingly.
(To avoid significantly affecting your gaming experience, some overly exaggerated modifications will not be available. The currently available content can mostly greatly shorten the time it takes to gather resources and help you quickly get through the early stages of the game.)


1.Fixed an issue where there was a chance that the mouse couldn't be moved when both the left and right mouse buttons were clicked on the technology icon simultaneously.
2.Fixed a problem where saving was not possible when there were too many save files.
3.Fixed a crash that occurred under specific circumstances.
4.Readded the achievement feature.
5.The Creative Workshop will be reopened in the next update.
6.Retranslated the untranslated parts in the English version.

A level - 0 new account maliciously slandered and spread rumors in the store review section, such as claiming that the Gensokyo project is a skin - swapping mass - produced game and that we're about to abandon it. As a result, many casual players believed these rumors. If you come across any rumors about the Gensokyo project being a skin - swapping game or us planning to abandon it, we hope you can help clarify the truth and leave a refuting comment in the store review section. This is of great importance to us. Thank you.

Finally, we will release the first DLC before next Friday and reopen the Creative Workshop.

notes.title: Ver2.4.3
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where releasing certain skills could cause the game to crash.
2.Fixed the display bug caused by a large number of engine upgrades.
3.Added new bloodlines: Dragonborn, Jungle Great Bear, Children of Chaos, as well as Dragon Clan, Bear Spirit, Chaos Offspring, etc.
4.ignificantly increased the rewards of world bosses.
5.Added a large number of new bloodline materials in various locations throughout the game.

We have received numerous suggestions from veteran players. In the next version, we will build in a game modifier to make the gameplay smoother. (New players should use it with caution as it may affect the gaming experience to some extent.)

At the same time, the new DLC "Giant Mythical Beasts: Frost Giants" and new elven legendary heroes are under optimization and will be released in the upcoming versions.
